summary: The Runware Grant Program awards up to $30,000 in API credits usable over 12 months across Runware's production platform — image, video, image/video editing, audio, LLMs, 3D, and avatar models on one API. Each grant starts with a fixed initial allocation sized to the team's stage and product; the $30,000 ceiling is not a universal award. Top-ups and renewals are conditional on actively consuming credits and staying engaged, not automatic. For early-stage teams (before Series A; bootstrapped welcome) with a real product or credible MVP, building or launching on Runware within six months, reachable at a business email. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis: the page body says within two weeks, while its FAQ aims for a few business days. No equity is taken. After the 12-month grant, the account moves to standard pay-as-you-go pricing.
claim_steps: Submit the grant form at https://runware.ai/grant-program with product, stage, traction, and expected Runware usage.
Eligibility: pre-Series A or bootstrapped, credible MVP, business email, building/launching within 6 months.
The page body says review within two weeks; the FAQ aims for a few business days. If approved, check your initial credit allocation; up to $30,000 is a ceiling, not a guaranteed award.
Top-ups and renewals are conditional on active credit usage and program engagement; do not assume automatic replenishment.
Plan for billing: after the 12-month grant, your account moves to standard pay-as-you-go pricing.
